## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO) and contributed under Apache-2.0.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, databases, backups, model weights or personal data included.
- [ ] Tests and documentation updated; documentation describes only what is implemented.
- [ ] AI assistance, if any, is mentioned in the description and reviewed by me.
